title: Yaw MCP CLI configuration (.yaw-mcp/config.json)
description: Configuration file for the @yawlabs/mcp CLI (bin `yaw-mcp`), which loads MCP servers from your local ~/.yaw-mcp/bundles.json. Resolved in precedence order (most-specific to least-specific): <project>/.yaw-mcp/config.local.json  >  <project>/.yaw-mcp/config.json  >  ~/.yaw-mcp/config.json. The project `.yaw-mcp/` directory is found by walking up from the current directory -- stopping just before $HOME when started under it; a directory outside $HOME walks to the filesystem root with an ownership check. JSONC (comments) is permitted.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema, enabling IDE autocomplete in editors that honor $schema.

version.description: Config schema version. Current version: 1. A value newer than the CLI understands triggers a warning but is not fatal. Declared `integer` with `minimum: 1` because that is the only shape yaw-mcp ever writes or documents. The loader (config-loader.ts readConfigAt) is deliberately more lenient -- it honors ANY numeric value and only warns when it exceeds the version it knows, so a hand-written `0` or `1.5` still loads. That gap is intentional: this schema is the editor-facing contract (flag the typo while it is being typed), the loader soft-fails by design (never refuse a file over a field it can ignore). A NON-number (`"1"`, null) is rejected here and warned about there.

token.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. yaw-mcp is local-only and no longer contacts a hosted API, so nothing reads this key. Delete it from your config, and revoke the PAT at its source -- deleting it here does not deactivate it. The property is retained (and its `mcp_pat_` pattern relaxed) only because this schema sets additionalProperties:false: removing it would mark every existing user config invalid.

apiBase.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. yaw-mcp is local-only and no longer contacts a hosted API. Delete it from your config. Retained for the same additionalProperties:false reason as `token`.

installNudge.description: Opt in to the shadow-driven install nudge in `discover`: when a recent shell command is shadowed by an MCP server you have not installed, discover suggests it. Off unless explicitly true. Resolved most-specific-scope-wins (local > project > global). The YAW_MCP_INSTALL_NUDGE=1 environment variable enables it independently.

servers.description: Allow-list of server namespaces to activate. If set in any scope, only these servers are active. Precedence: local scope wins over project, which wins over global (most-specific overrides). Entries are matched literally against an installed namespace, so `pattern` mirrors NAMESPACE_RE (src/local-bundles.ts): a lowercase letter followed by up to 29 more of [a-z0-9_]. A blank, padded, or wrong-case entry ('GitHub', ' github') can never name a server. The loader is softer about the same three cases, and the split is deliberate -- it drops a blank entry with a warning, trims a padded one, and KEEPS an unmatchable one with a warning (dropping it would empty the array and silently promote this scope to the parent's allow-list). `uniqueItems` likewise flags a repeated namespace in the editor, where it is always a typo; the loader treats the duplicate as the harmless no-op it is.

blocked.description: Deny-list of server namespaces that are never activated. Merged as a union across all scopes (additive, not overriding). Same namespace `pattern` and `uniqueItems` as `servers`, and the same strict-schema / lenient-loader split: the union is a Set, so the loader absorbs a duplicate rather than rejecting it.
